title: Battle of Podhajce (1698)
text: The Battle of Podhajce took place on 8–9 September 1698 near Podhajce in Ruthenian Voivodship during the Great Turkish War. In response to the impending military campaign of the Polish, the Ottoman Empire made a pre-emptive strike on the area of Commonwealth. Near Podhajce, the Polish army under Field Crown Hetman Feliks Kazimierz Potocki repelled the Crimean Tatar expedition under Qaplan I Giray.
